# Solar Velvet

> Solar Velvet is a cinematic music project built around two voices and two connected worlds: Golden Hours and Midnight Rooms.

Official website: https://solarvelvet.com/
Official YouTube channel: https://www.youtube.com/@solarvelvetmusic
Contact: info@solarvelvet.com

## Golden Hours

Golden Hours features Chill Disco, Nu Disco and Sunset Funk with airy female vocals. Its visual world is inspired by golden hour, coastal drives, Riviera nights, rooftops and endless summer.

Albums and sessions:

- Riviera Nights, Episode 001: https://youtu.be/d-JhjZPDxJM
- Vinyl Nights, Episode 002: https://youtu.be/gNwOitM9X2U
- Palm Radio, Episode 004: coming soon

## Midnight Rooms

Midnight Rooms features Chill R&B, Late Night Soul and dreamy beats with a soft male tenor. Its visual world is intimate, nocturnal and warmly lit.

Albums and sessions:

- Stay Until Morning, Episode 003: https://youtu.be/iwtNlugTIic

## Brand summary

Solar Velvet connects the glow of sunset disco with the intimacy of late night R&B. The woman is the voice of Golden Hours. The man is the voice of Midnight Rooms. Together they form one cinematic music world.

## Listening occasions

Solar Velvet is suited to café ambience, cocktail bars, hotel lounges, coastal drives, sunset listening and relaxing evenings at home. Golden Hours offers chill disco, nu disco and sunset funk. Midnight Rooms offers chill R&B, late night soul and dreamy beats.

Available releases are free to listen to through the official Solar Velvet YouTube channel. Public or commercial playback may require permission or an appropriate music licence. Licensing enquiries: info@solarvelvet.com
